data.outcome_summary: Education at a Glance 2025: Chile is a descriptive country note that synthesises education-system characteristics using OECD indicator tables rather than presenting an original student-level predictive or causal analysis. It reports attainment patterns (including intergenerational mobility), labour-market outcomes by educational attainment (unemployment and wage premia), adult literacy proficiency levels and trends from the OECD Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC), and system-level education participation and financing indicators (e.g., early childhood enrolment, public vs private tertiary funding, expenditure per student). The note also provides contextual comparisons to OECD averages and to other OECD and partner countries in Latin America and the Caribbean. Because it does not specify microdata, plausible-value generation, or an estimation model, there are no ML performance metrics or PV/missing-data procedures to extract from the note itself.
